title: Rolling Sea
line: Every wave is the same wave, arriving.
idea: Starts whole: a two-block ukiyo-e print of five wave bands rolling in parallax under a vermilion sun and a far snow peak, a boat of rowers riding the middle swell.
loop: Each band travels exactly one pattern length; the boat pitches over the swell as the crew pulls.
poster: Inside the loop: the boat on the rise of a swell.
alt: Sketch in woodblock-print style: bands of curling indigo waves with foam beads roll to the right under a red sun and a snow-capped peak, and a boat of rowers rides the swell.

title: Bamboo Wind
line: You only see the wind by what it bends.
idea: Starts whole: a sumi-e grove on rice paper where the wind is the only actor; gusts bend the culms, shiver the leaves and tear a few loose.
loop: Two gusts and the restless breeze between them; leaves tumble across and dry-brush streaks of wind pass.
poster: Inside the loop: the grove leaning into a gust.
alt: Sketch in sumi ink: black and grey bamboo stalks with clusters of brush-stroke leaves bend and sway in gusts of wind on cream rice paper, with a red seal in the corner.

title: Orrery
line: Draw the heavens carefully enough and they start to turn.
idea: Draws on: a blueprint is drafted (compass-swung orbits, column, arms, planets, gear train, dimensions), then the machine accelerates from rest into steady motion.
loop: Planets turn four, three, two and one times, the gears once, twice and three times, with pencil-yellow trails behind the planets.
poster: Inside the loop: the orrery running, trails behind each planet.
alt: Sketch of a blueprint: a planetary orrery drawn in white lines on blue grid paper, with orbit ellipses, a yellow sun, planets on arms, a gear train and dimension lines; the planets and gears turn.

title: Night City
line: Every lit window is somebody still awake.
idea: Starts whole: a three-ink riso poster of a city under a big moon; windows switch on and off, a lit train crosses the elevated line and the river repeats it all upside down.
loop: The train makes one lap, clouds drift one lap, a few windows go dark and come back, the mast light blinks.
poster: Inside the loop: the train crossing in front of the towers.
alt: Sketch in risograph style: a blue and pink city skyline with yellow lit windows under a big yellow moon, a pink train crossing on an elevated line, and the city reflected in the river below.

title: Fiddlehead
line: It was holding all of this, rolled up small.
idea: Grows: on a brushed cyanotype, a fern crozier unrolls into a full frond as a pale photogram shadow, its leaflets opening behind the uncurling tip.
loop: The frond breathes in a draught; a band of sunlight passes over the print with dust turning in it.
poster: Inside the loop: the frond fully open beside a younger crozier.
alt: Sketch of a cyanotype sun print: on a brushed field of Prussian blue, a pale fern fiddlehead unrolls into a tall frond beside grass stems and a small curled crozier.

title: Murmuration
line: Thousands of birds, and not one of them is in charge.
idea: Starts whole: dusk over a reed bed, every tone a density of dots, and a flock of starlings, one dot a bird, pouring itself through shapes.
loop: The flock stretches, folds, throws off a wing that returns, with waves of density running through it; three stragglers flap to catch up.
poster: Inside the loop: the flock swooping in a long curved wing over the reeds.
alt: Sketch in stipple: a dusk sky over reeds made of ink dots, with a rose-coloured low sun, and a vast flock of starlings shown as dots that flows into changing shapes.

title: Lamplight
line: Everything on the table leans away from the light.
idea: Starts whole: an etched still life of a jug, two pears and a bowl under a hanging lamp that swings; the cross-hatched tone of the room and every shadow follow the light.
loop: Two swings of the lamp; cast shadows swing the other way, dark sides turn, a moth circles the bulb three times.
poster: Inside the loop: the lamp at the top of its swing, shadows thrown long.
alt: Sketch in etching style: a jug, two pears and a bowl on a table under a hanging lamp; the lamp swings and the cross-hatched shadows and pool of warm light move with it.

title: Sea Chart
line: The route is only ever the wake behind you.
idea: Draws on: an old chart inks itself in, border, coastlines and their ripple lines, compass rose and rhumb lines, a sea serpent and a cartouche, while a small ship is already under way.
loop: One whole voyage around the islands, a dotted red wake fading behind the ship, the serpent's coils rising and sinking.
poster: Inside the loop: the ship between the islands, its wake trailing.
alt: Sketch of an antique sea chart in sepia ink on stained vellum: islands with ripple lines, a compass rose, a sea serpent, and a small ship sailing a dotted red route around the islands.

title: Rain Window
line: The city dissolves, and the room gets warmer.
idea: Starts whole: an evening window in watercolour and pen, the city beyond dissolved wet into wet; the rain does the moving.
loop: Drops gather and run down the panes in stops and starts, headlights slide by, the far lights breathe and steam rises from a cup.
poster: Inside the loop: drops mid-run, headlights in the street.
alt: Sketch in watercolour: a window at night between rose curtains, rain drops on the glass and blurred city lights beyond, with a potted plant and a steaming cup on the sill.

title: Snow Fox
line: Curled up small enough, the winter goes around you.
idea: Starts whole: a black and vermilion linocut of a fox asleep in the snow under pines and a ringed moon; snow shows only where it crosses the black and the red.
loop: Snow falls in three depths; the fox breathes four times, flicks an ear twice and its tail tip once.
poster: Inside the loop: the fox asleep, snow crossing the night.
alt: Sketch as a black, red and cream linocut: a red fox curled asleep in snow below carved pine trees and a full moon with halo rings, with snow falling.

title: Aurora
line: The sky was drawing, and it would not hold still.
idea: Starts whole: soft pastel on black paper, two curtains of aurora rippling over mountains and pines, a still lake holding a darker copy.
loop: The curtains ripple, rise and fall, and pulses of light run along them; the lake repeats it, broken into strokes.
poster: Inside the loop: both curtains high over the ridge.
alt: Sketch in pastel on black paper: green and magenta curtains of aurora ripple above dark mountains and pines, reflected in a lake below a starry sky.

title: Jellyfish
line: It swims by closing its hand around the dark.
idea: Starts whole: three glowing jellyfish in dark water, each pulsing at its own rate, their tentacles trailing exactly where their bells have been.
loop: Five, six and nine pulses: each bell snaps shut and lifts, then relaxes and sinks back; marine snow drifts up past them.
poster: Inside the loop: the largest bell relaxed, tentacles streaming.
alt: Sketch in glowing pastel on black: three jellyfish in cyan, violet and pink pulse and drift in deep water, with long trailing tentacles and drifting particles.

title: Ring Dance
line: Nobody leads. Everybody holds on.
idea: Starts whole: after Matisse, five vermilion figures cut from painted paper dance in a ring on a green hill against ultramarine; every hand holds the next dancer's hand.
loop: The ring turns once in perspective; each dancer steps and kicks on its own count; the paper sun and sea-leaves sway.
poster: Inside the loop: the ring mid-step, one dancer kicking out.
alt: Sketch in cut paper after Matisse: five red figures holding hands dance in a turning ring on a green hill against a deep blue sky with yellow and cream paper shapes.

title: Paper Theatre
line: The sea was cardboard. We went anyway.
idea: Starts whole: a toy theatre in layered card plays a night at sea: wave flats on sticks, a paper boat, a gold moon on a thread, stars that twirl.
loop: The wave flats rock in counter-time, the boat rides and rolls, the moon swings, the stars turn to show their gilded backs, clouds slide on a wire.
poster: Inside the loop: the boat on the swell under the swinging moon.
alt: Sketch of a toy paper theatre: red curtains frame a night sea of layered teal paper waves with a paper sailing boat, a gold crescent moon and stars hanging on threads.

title: Truchet
line: Turn one tile and the whole path changes.
idea: Starts whole: a screen-printed grid of Truchet tiles, black quarter-circle bands with red, yellow and blue corners.
loop: Four diagonal waves of rotation cross the grid; each tile draws in and turns a quarter as a wave passes, breaking and rejoining the black paths.
poster: A rest between waves: every tile square in its place.
alt: Sketch in Bauhaus screen-print style: a grid of square tiles with black curved bands and red, yellow and blue quarter circles that rotate in waves, re-forming winding paths.

title: Four Beats
line: Every shape has its own way of hearing the same note.
idea: Starts whole: a painted score after Kandinsky, circle, triangle, zigzag string, dots, arc, chequerboard and rings across five staff lines, played by a red playhead.
loop: The playhead crosses once; the triangle spins, the string rings, the dots jump, the arc opens, the squares invert, the rings spread, and the big circle keeps four beats to the bar.
poster: Inside the loop: the playhead mid-score, the string still ringing.
alt: Sketch of a Kandinsky-style score: a yellow and blue ringed circle, a red triangle, a black zigzag, coloured dots, a blue arc, a chequerboard and violet rings on staff lines, each moving as a red playhead passes.

title: Moon Tides
line: A whole month in one breath of the sea.
idea: Starts whole: gold on black lacquer, a stepped deco frame, a fan of rays, an engraved moon and a sea of scalloped rows.
loop: The moon goes new to full to new; the sea's rows rise with it and slide past each other; stars flash; a sheen of light travels once across all the gold.
poster: Inside the loop: the full moon over the high tide.
alt: Sketch in art deco gold on black: a moon engraved with fine lines passes through its phases above rows of teal and gold scalloped waves, inside a stepped gold frame with rays and star sparkles.

title: Fire Mountain
line: The island is still being made.
idea: Starts whole: a four-ink riso travel poster of a volcano island at sunset in orange, teal, purple and yellow.
loop: Smoke puffs lift from the crater lit orange from below and drift off as purple cloud; the lava glows and dims; the sun's road shivers on the sea; palms sway and birds cross.
poster: Inside the loop: a fresh puff over the glowing crater.
alt: Sketch in risograph style: a teal volcano with orange lava streams smokes under a purple and orange sunset sky with a striped yellow sun, palm silhouettes in the foreground and a sea below.

title: Cyclist
line: Keep the line going and it takes you somewhere.
idea: Draws on: one black line inks the hills, the road and the poles, then a bicycle in one unbroken stroke and its rider in another; then the ride starts.
loop: The world passes in parallax, hills and clouds at half speed, bushes at three quarters, poles at full; the pedals turn eight times and the wheels twelve.
poster: Inside the loop: mid-ride, poles passing, the red sun overhead.
alt: Sketch in a single black line on white: a cyclist rides past rolling hills, bushes, telegraph poles and clouds under a red sun, drawn as one continuous pen line.

title: Koi
line: Two fish, one circle, no beginning.
idea: Starts whole: a pond seen from above in soot ink and vermilion, lily pads in grey wash, and two koi, one white and red, one ink-dark, circling like the halves of a yin-yang.
loop: Each koi swims once around, its body bending along its own path, tail sweeping and fins paddling; rings spread where tails flicked.
poster: Inside the loop: the two koi on opposite sides of their circle.
alt: Sketch in sumi ink: seen from above, a red and white koi and a black koi swim in a slow circle around each other among grey lily pads, with ripples on the water and a red seal.
